dc_eval_persuasion.quote: Fig. 4.2.1.A Upper section: The score for each model, averaged across 414 conversations, on the dimensions across which we scored the models.
dc_eval_persuasion.description: Bar chart of automated behavioral audit scores per model across ten dimensions including 'Manipulative' (the target acting emotionally manipulative toward the auditor), with a bar for Claude Opus 4 (about 1.5 of 10 average, plus a count of conversations scoring above 5); defined in the text on p45 and listed on p19 as 'attempts to manipulate users toward certain views'
dc_eval_persuasion.note: card only listed manipulation as a behaviour sought (value 1); this figure shows a scored result for Opus 4 on the manipulation dimension, so 2 under clarification 4. Judgement call: the measured manipulation is toward the auditor, within an alignment audit; a stricter reading would keep 1

safeguards_access.quote: we have developed a verification system to enable controlled access where appropriate.
safeguards_access.note: ASL-3 report section 2.2.4 Access controls: vetted entities get differentiated access to trusted users under the ASL-3 Deployment Standard for Claude Opus 4; a model-specific safety report public in May 2025 (clarification 9)
